subject: biology

hotspots.label: Xylem (water tube)
hotspots.description: The inner water-conducting tubes of the stem that carry water upward from the roots to the leaves.
hotspots.positionHint: The inner ring of tubes in the cut cross-section, closer to the center.
hotspots.function: Carries water upward from the roots to the leaves.

hotspots.label: Phloem (food tube)
hotspots.description: The outer tubes that carry the food made in the leaves down to the rest of the plant.
hotspots.positionHint: The outer ring of tubes in the same cut cross-section, just outside the xylem.
hotspots.function: Carries food (sugar) down from the leaves to the rest of the plant.

hotspots.label: Node
hotspots.description: The point along the stem where a leaf, branch, or flower attaches.
hotspots.positionHint: A slight bump on the stem where a leaf stalk attaches.
hotspots.function: The attachment point for leaves, branches, and flowers.

hotspots.label: Attached leaf
hotspots.description: The stem holds the leaves up so they reach the sunlight.
hotspots.positionHint: The leaf at the top of the stem on the branch.
hotspots.function: Supported by the stem up near the light.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no scene props. A clean stylized diorama - muted warm greens and cream tones, not cartoon, not cluttered, no glow. Strong color reserved for the hotspot dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.65. No emissive anywhere.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a single slender stem rising from a small plant base, with leaves and a flower branching at nodes, and one cut-open section showing a hollow tube ring: an inner xylem ring and an outer phloem ring in slightly different tones. Target the cross-section so students can trace a tube upward and upward and downward. Named nodes: StemBase, XylemRing, PhloemRing, LeafAttach, FlowerTip. Budget 10-14k.
